description:
Install an interior archway (open passage) in the sample house. 

Starting with the default sample house loaded in DreamPlan:
1. Navigate to the 'Building' tab and select 'Doors'.
2. Locate the 'Arches' or 'Openings' category in the catalog (do NOT use a standard hinged door).
3. Place an Archway on an interior wall (e.g., between Hall and Living Room).
4. Verify in 3D view that the opening is clear/open.
5. Save the project to preserve changes.
